description.narrative: Contributo in supporto delle attività del Segretariato per l'Unione del Mediterraneo

The contribution aims to support the UpM Sectretariat activities. The Union for the Mediterranean is an intergovernmental organisation that promotes dialogue and political cooperation between member States in areas such as economy, environment, energy and migration. The strategic objectives of the Union's work include sustainable human development, pursued in specific areas such as environmental protection, blue economy, energy and climate action.
